segments.name: real estate
segments.description: Owns, manages, leases and repositions Manhattan office, retail and residential properties, earning rent from tenants and income from joint venture properties.
segments.evidence: For the real estate segment, the primary sources of revenue are tenant rents and escalations and reimbursement revenue.

segments.name: debt and preferred equity investments
segments.description: Holds debt and preferred equity investments and the Fund, financing New York City commercial real estate and earning interest and fee income.
segments.evidence: We allocate loan loss reserves, net of recoveries, and transaction related costs to the debt and preferred equity segment.

segments.name: SUMMIT
segments.description: Operates one location at One Vanderbilt Avenue in midtown Manhattan, with revenue generated primarily from selling tickets.
segments.evidence: SUMMIT currently operates one location at One Vanderbilt Avenue in midtown Manhattan with the primary source of revenue generated from ticket sales.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent, escalations and reimbursements for office, retail and residential space; borrowers pay interest and fees; SUMMIT visitors pay for tickets.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's primary sources of real estate revenue are tenant rents, escalations and reimbursement revenue.
